title: Copilot Studio: Review panel shows agent readiness and policy blocks while building
summary: Hold: the statement that Microsoft Learn names no role for the guidance settings is too broad. Microsoft documents Power Platform tenant administrators configuring environment-group rules, which include Maker guidelines; the roadmap facts, billing statements and listed commands are supported.

claims.quote: "status": "Launched", "statusKey": "launched"

claims.claim: The roadmap release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.claim: The roadmap target is September CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "September CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap supplies no preview date.

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope

claims.claim: The roadmap description does not identify which harness it covers.
claims.quote: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents.

claims.claim: Agent Readiness surfaces publishing risks and policy restrictions during building, with blocked capabilities grayed out.
claims.quote: A single "Review" indicator in the build experience surfaces anything blocking or at risk — from policy restrictions to missing evaluations — before it derails a publish. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front with a clear reason

claims.quote: As you build an agent powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness, the Review entry point gives you a single place to see issues that affect your agent's readiness, governance, and security.

claims.claim: Review surfaces problems caused by data policies and Advanced Connector Policies.
claims.quote: It surfaces problems caused by data policies, Advanced Connector Policies, and other organizational controls, so you can find and resolve them before they block publishing.

claims.claim: The Review icon appears in the top menu bar.
claims.quote: The Review icon appears in the top menu bar.

claims.claim: The Review icon is always visible while the maker builds the agent.
claims.quote: It's always visible while you build your agent, and the icon shows the number of outstanding issues.

claims.claim: The Review icon shows the number of outstanding issues.
claims.quote: the icon shows the number of outstanding issues.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; controls[2].note; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Maker guidelines is available only for managed environments.
claims.quote: Maker guidelines is available only for managed environments.

claims.claim: Maker guidelines can be configured for an individual managed environment or an environment group in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: You can configure maker guidelines for an individual managed environment or for an environment group. ... Sign in to the Power Platform admin center.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn names no role for the guidance settings.
claims.quote: After you create the environment group, Power Platform tenant administrators can immediately add managed environments or configure the group's rules.
claims.fix: Remove 'Microsoft Learn names no role for these settings at the time of writing.' Maker guidelines is explicitly an environment-group rule at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/environment-groups-rules, and https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/environment-groups names Power Platform tenant administrators for configuring group rules. In the last Open questions bullet, replace 'with which roles and API support' with 'with what API support'.

claims.claim: The Power Platform admin center path Security > Data and privacy > Data policy > policy > Edit Policy > Next > Next > connector > three dots > Block reaches connector blocking.
claims.quote: select Security, and then select Data and privacy. ... Select Data policy. ... select the data policy and select Edit Policy. ... Select Next. ... Select Next. ... Select the three dots ... next to the connector ... select Block.

claims.claim: Set-DlpPolicy -PolicyName <policy name> -UpdatedPolicy <DLPPolicyDefinition object> updates a data policy using its updated policy object.
claims.quote: Updates a policy by using the UpdatedPolicy DLPPolicyDefinition object. ... Set-DlpPolicy -PolicyName <String> -UpdatedPolicy <Object>
